name: Janpath
notes: The craft market is described by what it sells and how it looks, not by who sells it.

buildings.balconies: none: a flat-roofed market row with a first floor sign band; shuttered windows on the office side
buildings.roofline: flat roofs; a red and cream painted band at the top of the market row

gate_and_window_grilles.kind: roll-down steel shutters on the market row, no front wall on the office side

footpath.surface: a raised paved walk with a red and cream chequer band on the market side; grey paver on the road side
footpath.kerb: yellow and black painted kerb stripe

lamps.kind: tall double-arm steel pole in the median
lamps.notes: bulbs and fairy lights over the market and in the trees at night

signs.boards: shop signs on the first floor and brand boards on the office blocks; green direction boards in Hindi, Urdu and English

life.people: shoppers and visitors, sellers sitting at open shutters or standing in front, a few juice sellers and a small cafe; the market is lit and busiest at night

road.condition: good mid-grey asphalt on a dual carriageway with a planted median about 2 m wide; a narrow patched service lane beside the shops

evidence.buildings.mix: sheet janpath 'Buildings': a long low two storey market row with open fronts, and on the office side 4 to 6 storey concrete blocks with brand boards. Shares are an estimate
evidence.buildings.floors: sheet janpath 'Buildings': two storey market row, 4 to 6 storey office blocks
evidence.buildings.colours: sheet janpath 'Buildings': a red and cream painted band at the top of the market row; 4 to 6 storey concrete blocks
evidence.buildings.materials: sheet janpath 'Buildings' and 'Boundaries': painted market row, concrete office blocks, roll-down shutters
evidence.buildings.balconies: sheet janpath 'Buildings': flat roofed row, signs on the first floor; office blocks with AC units and shuttered windows
evidence.buildings.roofline: sheet janpath 'Buildings': flat roofed, a red and cream painted band at the top
evidence.house_railings: sheet janpath 'Boundaries': shutters and a painted welcome wall at the market entrance; office blocks along the east side have no front wall
evidence.footpath: sheet janpath 'Footpaths': market frontage a raised paved walk about 3 m wide with a red and cream chequer band, road side grey paver about 2.5 m with a yellow and black kerb stripe
evidence.lamps: sheet janpath 'Street lamps': tall double-arm steel poles in the median with sodium lights; small shop-side bulbs and fairy lights over the market; the sheet gives no pole height or spacing
evidence.boundaries: sheet janpath 'Boundaries': low black railing in the median, green direction boards, shutters; no heights in the sheet
evidence.greenery: sheet janpath 'Trees and planting': large mature roadside trees (jamun, neem, peepal-like) forming a canopy over the road
evidence.signs: sheet janpath 'Buildings' (shop signs on the first floor, brand boards, many boards in English only) and 'Boundaries' (green direction boards with Hindi, Urdu and English)
evidence.life: sheet janpath 'Vendors and street life' (a tourist market: bags, bracelets, curios, sellers at open shutters, a small cafe and juice sellers; lit stalls at night) and 'Parking and vehicles' (autos and taxis along the service lane, motorbikes in front of shops)
evidence.sound: sheet janpath 'What makes this area unlike the others': a tree-lined dual carriageway with a low row of craft shops at its side
evidence.wear: sheet janpath 'Typical clutter and wear': wear 0.25; DELHI_WORLD.md 2a table 0.25
evidence.road: sheet janpath 'Road surface and markings': dual carriageway, two lanes each way, a planted median about 2 m wide, good mid-grey asphalt; the service lane is narrow, patched asphalt with leaf litter
